Euler_torsion_pair.statement: T is characterized by strict positive Euler value of every nonzero quotient; F by strict negative Euler value of every nonzero subobject. The sign of the total object is insufficient.

finite_ADE_selection.state: Abstract conditional theorem proved in the manuscript.
finite_ADE_selection.hypotheses: An Ext-finite 2-Calabi-Yau ambient triangulated category, bounded finite-length old heart with spherical simples of finite ADE type, a bounded target heart within amplitude [0,1], and an additive integral function strictly positive on nonzero target-heart objects.
finite_ADE_selection.statement: Negative-simple tilts terminate at the specified target heart after exactly the initial number of negative positive roots. The terminal heart and its simple-root system are independent of the negative-simple choices.
finite_ADE_selection.prior_mechanism: Simple tilts and ADE Weyl reflection are prior theory. The application selects the actual anticanonical target using the specified structure-object Euler function.
finite_ADE_selection.not_asserted: Different paths give naturally isomorphic composite autoequivalences; or a full geometric-family wall-crossing/stability-space theorem.
